scenarios.title: A resolved flashback spell is exiled instead of going to the graveyard
decisions: A casts Firebolt from the graveyard for its flashback cost {4}{R}, tapping all five Mountains, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: flashback
variants.expected: Firebolt deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed and is in B's graveyard. Firebolt is exiled, not put into A's graveyard.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: Firebolt is in A's hand instead of the graveyard and A casts it for its mana cost {R}.
variants.expected: Firebolt deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. Firebolt is put into A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A countered flashback spell is exiled instead of going to the graveyard
decisions: A casts Firebolt from the graveyard for its flashback cost {4}{R}, tapping all five Mountains, targeting Grizzly Bears.
B responds with Counterspell targeting Firebolt, tapping both Islands.

variants.label: flashback
variants.expected: Firebolt is countered and is exiled instead of going to A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears is undamaged.

variants.label: hard_cast
variants.delta: Firebolt is in A's hand instead of the graveyard and A casts it for its mana cost {R}.
variants.expected: Firebolt is countered and is put into A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears is undamaged.

scenarios.title: A flashback card can be cast from the graveyard only if the flashback cost can be paid
decisions: A tries to cast the card from the graveyard targeting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: flashback_payable
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt from the graveyard for {4}{R} is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: flashback_unaffordable
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt from the graveyard is illegal (can_play false): {4}{R} cannot be paid.

variants.label: in_exile
variants.delta: Firebolt is in A's exile zone instead of the graveyard.
variants.expected: Casting Firebolt is illegal (can_play false): flashback functions only in the graveyard.

variants.label: no_flashback_card
variants.delta: A's graveyard holds Shock instead of Firebolt.
variants.expected: Casting Shock from the graveyard is illegal (can_play false): it has no flashback.
